name: Quiet Signals Health Guard
description: Health factor agent for BNB Chain. Monitors Venus Core Pool lending positions: reads account liquidity, shortfall and health factor for any address, returns a JSON risk report, and takes protective on-chain actions (interest-index refresh check-ins, collateral toggles, small repays) when the health factor drops below a threshold.

skills.name: Venus health-factor report
skills.description: Input: a BNB Chain address. Output: JSON with collateral, debt, liquidity, shortfall, health factor, status (NO_DEBT/HEALTHY/AT_RISK/LIQUIDATABLE) and the recommended protective action.

skills.name: Protective action
skills.description: When HF < threshold (default 1.2): prepares and, for the owner wallet, executes a zero-value protective tx on Venus (accrueInterest check-in, enterMarkets/exitMarket collateral toggle, or a small repayBorrow).
